subject.title: Feishu Bitable write operations return 400 after bot/app replacement

question: Should Feishu Bitable table-level operations after app replacement remain app-credential operations with better diagnostics, or should OpenClaw add a user-auth path for these table tools?
rationale: The code shows app-credential Bitable tool execution and an unresolved account-precedence overlap, but the issue lacks the Feishu error body/code/log_id needed to choose diagnostics, resolver precedence, or new auth behavior.

options.title: Request live Feishu error evidence first
options.body: Keep this issue open until the reporter or a maintainer provides the exact Feishu response body/code/log_id from the failing table operation.

options.title: Fold into account-precedence work
options.body: Treat this as part of the Feishu non-inbound wrong-account routing issue only after confirming the failing run used the wrong configured account.

options.title: Sponsor user-auth design
options.body: Open a maintainer-owned design for user_access_token support if Feishu confirms table-level operations require user context after app replacement.

recommendation.title: Request live Feishu error evidence first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the reporter or a maintainer provides the exact Feishu response body/code/log_id from the failing table operation.

likelyOwner.reason: The account-aware Feishu tool routing refactor is the strongest feature-history signal for the affected account/auth behavior.
